title: FOC P09 precision resistor check

status.selection: Technically suitable at component-selection stage for both actual divider-bottom positions
status.e100: Not a P09/FOC OVP error metric. FOC complete threshold-error and bench qualification remain OPEN; the separate steady-state per-cell protection E100 gate is unchanged and remains open under its original-module qualification record.

carrier.note: Procurement MPN and retained CAD carrier are distinct; no land geometry was measured or changed.

manufacturer_datasheet.endurance_test: 70±2°C, rated continuous working voltage, 1000 h cycling 1.5 h on / 0.5 h off; ±0.5% maximum resistance change

supplier.price_stock_moq: Not verified; request current quote, stock/MOQ and lot traceability.

baseline.comparison: Same 0603, 10 kΩ, ±0.1%, ±25 ppm/°C, 0.1 W at 70°C, 75 V table limit and -55°C to +155°C range.
baseline.endurance: Yageo ±(0.5%+0.05 Ω) = ±0.5005% at 10 kΩ; HoAR ±0.5%, so quoted endurance drift does not worsen.

R_OVBOT.network: 162 kΩ top / 10 kΩ bottom; 50 V BUS input

R_OVREF_BOT.network: 10.2 kΩ top / 10 kΩ bottom; SAFE_5V=4.97648 V

actual_circuit_stress.note: 50 V is the BUS input, not the voltage across either bottom resistor. Nominal power is about 0.85% / 0.61% of rating. The ±0.5% corners vary only the bottom resistor, holding source and top resistor nominal; they omit other loop tolerances and are not a qualification result.

release_checks: Measure current R0603 copper land against HoAR recommended land dimensions A=0.8 mm, B=1.0 mm, C=0.9±0.2 mm.
Confirm derated power and board self-heating at actual operating temperature.
Verify current quote, stock/MOQ and lot traceability.
qualification_actions: Complete the FOC OVP threshold-error analysis with the exact new part, upper/lower resistor initial tolerance/TCR/endurance, reference/source/comparator, temperature and transient bounds.

Require no worse error than the old-part baseline and compliance with the applicable documented FOC OVP acceptance window; maintain OPEN until demonstrated. Do not apply the separate cell-protection E100 limit to this OVP screen.
Do not substitute a 10 ppm part; exact recommended MPN is ±25 ppm/°C.
